label: Experimental result
note: A source reports measured behavior; consult scope, conditions, diagnostics and provenance.

label: Model or design
note: A calculation, simulation or design publication; not an experimental result.

label: Related experimental heritage
note: Result belongs to a different facility or organization, with transfer limits.

label: Engineering progress
note: Construction, integration or component-development progress with a stated scope.

label: Reported status
note: Institutional or company summary that must retain its wording and limits.

label: Organization or strategy event
note: A financing, agreement or roadmap event, not physical performance.

label: Announced target
note: A future objective; a passed date never automatically changes its status.
